rationale: The agent did locate the user via name and ZIP, but then executed multiple order-changing actions (two cancellations and a return) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every write and the user’s stated preference to do one thing at a time. The agent also failed to provide the requested tracking number for the tablet and did not address or escalate the lost-tablet refund/reorder question. The final message only mentions the sneaker return and omits the status of the charger and boot/kettle orders. While actions appear to be on the correct account, lack of confirmation and incomplete fulfillment of the user’s requests means the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
